finding.reproduction: Compiled and executed the exact pre-extraction If AST against a scratch airootfs.sfs symlink whose target is missing. The symlink exists but guard passed. No xorriso execution or actual overwrite claim.
finding.impact: Does not enforce documented exclusive owned output before extraction; the later type check cannot prove an existing entry was untouched. Path.exists can also classify stat failures as absence.
finding.recommendedFix: Use lstat; authorize extraction only on FileNotFoundError. Deny every existing entry, including regular file/directory/dangling link, and fail closed on other stat errors. Preserve entries; do not delete them.
finding.requiredRetake: Absent output permits next stage; regular/directory/dangling/permission-error cases deny before the extraction call.
